test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

The Chief Minister said, “All exams shall be cancelled this year.”

options.text: The Chief Minister said that all exams should be cancelled this year.
The Chief Minister says that all exams shall be cancelled this year.
The Chief Minister said that all exams would be cancelled that year.
The Chief Minister said that all exams should have been cancelled that year.

solution:
The correct answer is **'The Chief Minister said that all exams would be cancelled that year'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given question we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be added and comma and inverted commas will be removed.
 
• '**said**' will not change because reporting verb does not have **an object.**
 
• **'shall be cancelled this year' **change into **'would be cancelled that year'.**

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The Chief Minister said that all exams would be cancelled that year.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य Direct Speech में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Indirect Speech में बदलना है।
 
• परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• Conjunction 'that' जोड़ा जाएगा और comma और inverted commas हटा दिए जाएंगे।
 
• '**said**' नहीं बदलेगा क्योंकि **reporting verb** में कोई **object** नहीं है।
 
• **'shall be cancelled this year'** में परिवर्तन **'would be cancelled that year'**।
